tactics: induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith]
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipWith, -List.getElem_zipWith]

induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih => cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs => cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => exact ih bs i (by simp at h; omega)
